A · Roles & Access Model

Every screen in WH is protected by role-based access control (RBAC). What a person sees and can do is decided by the role(s) assigned to their account and by a scope that limits which records they may touch. This section explains the model once; each module below then lists who may use it.

The permission grid — 24 menus × 6 actions

Access is expressed as menu.action. There are 24 menus (one per module, plus the administration areas) and 6 actions on each:

View
open and read the module
Create
add a new record
Edit
change an existing record
Delete
remove a record (soft-delete, with a reason — recoverable)
Activate
advance / approve / enable (e.g. approve a borrow)
Deactivate
cancel / disable
Settings › Roles & permissions — the grid where each role's 6 actions per menu, plus the four scope rules, are set. Only a super_admin may change it.

The eight roles

RoleWhat they are for
super_adminFull control of everything, including RBAC itself. Bypasses all permission checks.
adminFull control of all modules except editing RBAC (can view roles, not change them).
warehouse_staffRuns day-to-day warehouse operations: inventory, hand-over/return, deposit, dispatch, inspections, disposal.
approverApproves / signs transactions assigned to them (borrow, deposit, request, DA, disposal).
line_managerSame actions as approver, but scoped to their department.
requesterRaises their own borrow / deposit / request; views inventory and catalog.
supplierMaintains their own product catalogue and sees their own orders / OGA.
department_adminManages the equipment of their own department only.

Scope — how far a role can reach

On top of the actions, four scope rules decide which records a role may act on. The highest-privilege role a person holds wins.

ScopeMeaning
Allevery record in the system
Departmentonly records belonging to the person's department
Assignedonly records where the person is the named approver
Ownonly records the person created
Own supplier / ordersonly the supplier's own catalogue and orders
Who defines the permissions? A super_admin sets every role's grid and scope in Settings › Roles & permissions. The super_admin role itself is locked (read-only) so it can never be weakened by accident. People are given roles in Settings › Users; only a super_admin may grant the super_admin role. All permission changes and record actions are written to the Audit log.

Access legend used below — Full all six actions   Manage create/edit + activate/deactivate, no delete   Create & approve view/create/activate   Create & edit raise & change own   View read-only

B · Modules

B1 Dashboard

The landing screen after sign-in — KPIs, an action queue of items awaiting the user, recent activity and 6-month trend charts.

What it is

The home screen. It summarises the warehouse at a glance and routes the user to whatever needs their attention.

Purpose

Give every user a personalised overview — active borrows, requests to receive, deposits to store, items awaiting their approval — and quick trends. Tiles and their detail adapt to the user's role and scope.

Workflow

Sign in→See KPIs + action queue→Click an item→Jump to that record

Access & permissions

RoleAccessScope
All rolesViewPersonal — tiles and queue reflect the user's own role & scope

B2 WH Inventories

The stock register — thousands of warehouse items with quantity, unit, location, photo and status; supports CSV import and delete-with-reason.

What it is

The master register of everything held in the warehouse — the single source of truth for stock on hand.

Purpose

Record and track each item's quantity, unit, storage location, photo and status (available / borrowed / maintenance / low-stock). It feeds borrow, deposit, request and disposal.

Workflow

Add / import items→Maintain quantity & details→Consumed by other modules→Delete-with-reason if retired

Access & permissions

RoleAccessScope
super_admin / adminFullAll
warehouse_staffManageAll
requester · approver · department_adminViewAll

B3 Borrowing Material / Tools

Borrow register with per-item photos, borrower, return schedule and live status (active, overdue, returned) — shown with the 78 records migrated from the old system.

What it is

The loan workflow for warehouse items and tools — from request, through approval and hand-over, to return.

Purpose

Control who has borrowed what, enforce return dates, and keep photographic proof at hand-over and return. Supports progressive partial return (receiving a multi-item slip back in stages) when enabled, and overdue tracking.

Workflow

Draft→Acknowledged→Approved→Active (handed over)→Returned

Acknowledge and approve steps are configurable in settings; stock is decremented at hand-over and restored on return.

Access & permissions

RoleAccessScope
super_admin / adminFullAll
warehouse_staffManage — hand over & receiveAll
approverCreate & approveAssigned
line_managerCreate & approveDepartment
requesterCreate & edit — raise / cancelOwn
department_adminView—

B4 Deposit Material / Equipment

Safe-keeping register — items left in the warehouse for storage, with an assigned shelf/location and per-item photos.

What it is

A safe-keeping service: items handed to the warehouse to be stored and later reclaimed by their owner.

Purpose

Track deposited items, assign a storage location/shelf, flag anything that needs fixing, and record the eventual claim — with photos throughout.

Workflow

Draft→Submitted→Accepted (location set)→Stored→Claimed

A stored item can be flagged needs-fix and returned to stored once resolved.

Access & permissions

RoleAccessScope
super_admin / adminFullAll
warehouse_staffManage — accept & storeAll
approver / line_managerCreate & approveAssigned / Department
requesterCreate & editOwn

B5 Request Material

Material requisition register — items requested out of the warehouse, with VAT snapshot and SAP (PR/FR) close-out tracking.

What it is

The requisition workflow for drawing materials out of the warehouse (ໃບເບີກວັດສະດຸ).

Purpose

Let staff request materials, route them for approval, have the warehouse validate and dispatch, confirm receipt (in full or in part), and close out against an invoice number and SAP reference (PR/FR). VAT is frozen at submission.

Workflow

Draft→Submitted→Approved→Validated→Dispatched→Received→Completed

Access & permissions

RoleAccessScope
super_admin / adminFullAll
approverCreate & approveAssigned
line_managerCreate & approveDepartment
requesterCreate & editOwn
warehouse_staff · supplier · department_adminViewAll / Own

B6 Shops Material (Catalog)

Supplier product catalogue — materials with net prices; suppliers maintain their own entries.

What it is

A catalogue of supplier products (materials) with prices, used as a reference when requesting or purchasing.

Purpose

Hold each supplier's product list and net pricing so requests and orders can reference real catalogue items. Suppliers keep their own entries current.

Workflow

Supplier adds products→Maintain price & details→Referenced by Request

Access & permissions

RoleAccessScope
super_admin / adminFullAll
supplierCreate & editOwn supplier
warehouse_staff · requesterViewAll

B7 Equipment & Tools

Equipment register with condition inspections and preventive/corrective maintenance, driven by re-usable checklist templates.

What it is

The asset register for equipment and tools, together with their inspection and maintenance history.

Purpose

Track each asset (code, owner department, quantity by condition, photo); run checklist inspections; plan and record preventive (PM) and corrective (CM) maintenance. A failed inspection item automatically raises a corrective work-order.

Workflow

Register asset→Inspect (pass / fail / follow-up)→Plan PM→Execute (planned → in progress → done)→Manager acknowledges

Maintenance types: preventive, repair (CM), service, other; frequencies monthly / quarterly / semi-annual / annual.

Access & permissions

RoleAccessScope
super_admin / adminFullAll
warehouse_staffManageAll
department_adminManageDepartment (own equipment only)

B8 Area Inspection

Workplace / area inspections against a template, each item scored Compliant / Non-Compliant / Not-Applicable.

What it is

A template-driven checklist for inspecting a workplace or area, keyed to a location.

Purpose

Record area / safety inspections. Each item is marked C (compliant), NC (non-compliant) or NA. Non-compliant items require an observation and a date-stamped photo; the next due date is computed automatically.

Workflow

Pick template + location→Mark C / NC / NA→Photo & note on NC→Manager acknowledges→PDF

Access & permissions

RoleAccessScope
super_admin / adminFullAll
warehouse_staffManageAll
approver / line_managerView + acknowledgeAll / Department

B9 Disposal

Write-off of scrap / retired assets through a five-stage sign-off, updating the source registers on completion.

What it is

The controlled write-off (ຈຳໜ່າຍ) of scrap or retired items, pulled from Inventory, Equipment or Deposit — or entered fresh.

Purpose

Retire assets with a full five-signer approval trail and, on completion, automatically update the source registers (equipment retired count, inventory de-activated, deposit annotated).

Workflow — five-stage sign-off

Preparer→Committee→Technical→Manager→Executive→Disposed

Access & permissions

RoleAccessScope
super_admin / adminFullAll
warehouse_staffManage — prepare listAll
approver / line_managerCreate & approve — sign a stageAssigned / Department
department_adminViewDepartment

B10 DA Claims — Discrepancy Advice

Discrepancy Advice — raised by the warehouse when goods received don't match, then reviewed by purchasing and approved by a leader.

What it is

A formal notice of a discrepancy in goods received (wrong quantity, damage, spec mismatch).

Purpose

Raise, investigate and resolve receiving discrepancies with a three-party trail (warehouse → purchasing → leader). A resolved DA can spawn an OGA when goods must be sent back.

Workflow

Draft→Submitted→Purchasing review→Pending approval→Resolved

Access & permissions

RoleAccessScope
super_admin / adminFullAll
warehouse_staffManage — raiseAll
approver / line_managerCreate & approve — purchasing / leader stepsAssigned / Department

B11 OGA — Outwards Goods Advice

Outwards Goods Advice — a dispatch note for goods leaving the warehouse, with driver, truck and weight.

What it is

A dispatch note recording goods sent out of the warehouse (including returns arising from a DA).

Purpose

Document outward movements — driver, truck plate, weight and delivery confirmation — so every item leaving the warehouse is accounted for.

Workflow

Draft→Dispatched→Delivered

A dispatched note may instead be marked returned with a reason.

Access & permissions

RoleAccessScope
super_admin / adminFullAll
warehouse_staffManageAll
supplierViewOwn orders

B12 Expo Info

A light record of exhibition / expo visits — events, companies and contacts met.

What it is

A small record-keeping area for trade-expo activity (event → company → contact → notes).

Purpose

Log visits to exhibitions and the suppliers/contacts met, as a lightweight reference for procurement follow-up.

Workflow

Record event→Add companies / contacts→Notes & report

Access & permissions

RoleAccessScope
super_admin / adminFullAll
warehouse_staffManageAll

B13 Administration (Settings)

Settings › Users — accounts, their roles and department; the hub where access is granted.

What it is

The administration hub: Users, Roles & permissions, Organization & Facilities (departments, locations, buildings, rooms), Units of measure, Suppliers, Translations, System settings, Notifications / Email, Audit log, Reports and Backup.

Purpose

Configure the system and control access. This is where accounts are created, roles are assigned, and the RBAC grid + scopes are defined; and where backups, the audit trail and reports live.

Workflow

Create user→Assign role(s) + department→Role grid decides access→Actions logged to Audit

Access & permissions

RoleAccessScope
super_adminFull — incl. editing RBACAll
adminFull except RBAC (View roles only)All
everyone elseNo access—
Chain of control: super_admin defines roles & scopes → assigns roles to users → each user then sees only what their role permits. The super_admin role is self-locked, and only a super_admin can create another.
